scope: Add read-only retention planning and explicit, path-confined cleanup for recovery, failed-write and conflict history in the Rust vault layer.
behavior: The default policy retains up to 30 days and 5 GiB, with policy values supplied by the caller.
Planning is read-only, orders records by capture time, reports retained/pruneable/protected bytes, and warns when protected data alone exceeds the cap.
Conflict records are always protected. Cleanup is an explicit call and removes only currently pruneable recovery/failed artifacts and their manifests.
The reader accepts Rust snake_case fields and legacy TypeScript camelCase fields, including epoch-second and ISO timestamps.
History directories and artifacts are checked as regular, non-symlink entries. Artifact locations are derived from validated record IDs; stored manifest paths cannot redirect cleanup.
